title: refuses … a record with no owner
refuses a record others reference, saying what references it
The merge fails when one ID is added on both sides with different content
when: Merges a data file's base, ours and theirs.
then: Expects a clash naming the key.

title: An ID another record has, of any kind, is refused
then: Expects a record with another kind's ID refused.

title: A missing, unknown or disallowed parent is refused, as is a second parent or a parent column on a kind with no owner
when: An aggregate with no domain or an unknown one, an endpoint, table or question with two parents or none, and a product or a kind with no owner given a parent column are loaded.
then: Each is refused; an endpoint under its query and a question under its product load.

title: refuses an ID that does not start with its parent's or domain's ID
A link whose relation is unknown or not allowed for its kinds is refused
when: Loads a link of a relation that has no table, and a view that fulfills a domain rule.
then: Expects an unknown-table refusal and a relation-pair refusal.

title: A link from a record of one product to a record of another is refused, whatever the relation; an ID in text is not a link
when: Adds an `involves` and an `applies` link from one product's records to another's, and loads text naming another product's ID.
then: Expects each link refused by `link-crosses-product`, and the text kept as written, with no link and no problem.

title: a command and a specification in different domains
a policy hearing another domain's unpublished event
A space's index holds only its product's records, links, parts, coverage and problems, and the records and problems of no product
when: With a link and a named ID from Demo shop into Notebook.
then: Expects each space's index to hold its own records, parts and those of no product, no link into the other, its own coverage, and its problems with the workspace's.

title: A list splits by kind only when it holds more than one kind, whatever the focus, depth or filters
then: Expects an aggregate's children of four kinds in a group each, a use case's seven requirements straight under it, the tree the same after a filtered, deeper neighborhood, and the record page titling a list of one kind by the kind and a mixed one Children.

title: Filters hide kinds and relations and paths through them, never the focus
when: Hides tests, then the satisfies relation, then views.
then: Expects the hidden records and lines to go, nothing to be reached through them, and the focus to stay even when its own kind is hidden.

title: The Links switch adds the records the focused record links to and from, one hop, in focus, with their links
when: Turns Links on at a requirement.
then: Expects what satisfies, fulfills and proves it, one step away and reached from it, with their links and no ring of their own; none with Links off; only the focus's own links at depth 3; and the same result on every call.

title: A folder opens only when it holds lathe.config.json or a data folder
when: Builds folders with a config, with only `data/`, with neither, with a broken config, and a plain file.
then: Checks which open and with which data folder, and what the refusals say; then checks the window title from the rows of `data/product.jsonl`.

title: In development the window uses the 5199 server only when it answers for the opened folder
when: Chooses the development source against a fake 5199 that answers for the folder, for another folder, without the header, with an error, or not at all.
then: Checks that a free port is never 5199 or a port in use.

title: A domain follows a pattern itself or through any of its use cases
when: A domain follows one pattern through its use case and another itself.
then: Expects both rules counted there, each once.

title: A rule whose setting every following use case marks not applicable does not apply in that domain
when: Both following use cases in a domain give the rule's setting a not-applicable reason.
then: Expects the rule neither counted nor reported there.

title: A rule no follower meets is waived in that domain, neither owed nor proved
then: Expects rules that apply when scope is not single, or is many, to be left out of the coverage and warnings of a domain whose only use case gives scope single, a proof of one there to count for nothing, and both to be owed in a domain where one use case gives " Many ".

title: Each domain that follows a pattern owes its rules, on one pattern rule line
then: Expects one `pattern_rule` coverage line in a following domain that counts both of the pattern's rules, designed, built and proved, and both rules counted in other following domains.
